description: Implicit definition is equivalent to existence of an old-language formula whose universally closed defining equivalence has a derivation from \(T\) in the existing first-order calculus.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.beth_derives.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ}
  (T : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.extended L n).Theory) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.Implicit T ↔
    ∃ ρ,
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.definingAxiom ρ)
